purpose: Overview of doc-link requirements: purpose, background, glossary, scope, responsibility boundaries, non-functional requirements, findings, and the decision and open-issue registers for the DocAdvisor replacement plugin.
summary: Purpose and background: replacing DocAdvisor with permanent document-ID based management instead of path-based keys
Overall flow diagram covering DLID check, assignment, link check, ToC build, and change-impact check with user confirmations
Document search flow with ToC rebuild check and the option to search an existing stale ToC
Glossary of terms such as DLID, document ID, section ID, ToC, content hash, and project management AI
Scope in and out, and the responsibility split between doc-link and the project management AI
Non-functional requirements: rebuild consistency, determinism, idempotence, write boundary limited to DLID, diagnosability, resumability, scalability
Error candidates and non-blocking findings that are recorded in the ToC without stopping its confirmation
Decision register D-001 to D-058 covering ID format, write rules, reference notation, hashing, operation flow, and search policy
Open-issue register U-001 onward, each marked decided or deferred to design
tasks: Understanding the overall goals and scope of doc-link
Looking up the definition of a glossary term before writing specifications
Checking a decision (D-xxx) before changing design or implementation
Designing or implementing DLID assignment and embedding
Designing or implementing ToC build, rebuild, and confirmation
Implementing reference checks and change-impact notification
Reviewing whether a change respects the write boundary and non-functional requirements
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — 総論
